from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single financial report with total assets information."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company or trust name from the filing")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of filing, e.g., 'Form 10-Q'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets reported for the period, in dollars")
    asset_currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of assets, e.g., 'USD'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
